messages:
alex: T-minus 45m until the change window. Quick check — smoke run, docs, and gatekeeper signoff. @maria you good to own gate?
maria: On it. Ran smoke locally — all green except one flaky test I disabled in the smoke set. PR #4821 updates the runbook + changelog.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: `canary/run v3.4.1-canary` at 1718889000. Pin applied to canary pool. Logs will stream to /deploys/canary/1718887777.
sunil: I put a short alert: latency > 250ms sustained for 2m OR error-rate > 1% -> pager. Also watching GPU mem pressure.
jess: Release notes are in Google Drive (link: https://drive.redwood/release/3.4.1). Calling out: embedding cost change and new caching config.
tim: Quick sanity: can we confirm credentials for the private cluster are rotated? Had an expired service account last week.
maria: Confirmed SA keys rotated last night. Updated `kube/secret` and redeployed secret-sync.
alex: Nice. Gatekeeper checklist: 1) smoke green, 2) docs updated, 3) canary pin set, 4) rollback doc present, 5) oncall assigned. Tick as you complete.
maria: 1 ✅ 2 ✅ 3 ✅ 4 -> added runbook link in PR body. 5 -> sunil is oncall.
sunil: Oncall confirmed. I'll post a short status every 10m during canary.
jess: Rollback plan: revert canary tag and route traffic back to v3.4.0; manual DB migration reversal not needed. I added step-by-step under /runbooks/rollback-3.4.1.
deploy-bot: Canary started — logs: ```
START 1718889000 canary v3.4.1-canary
healthcheck: ok
traffic: 5% -> canary
metrics-stream: /metrics/canary/1718887777
```
alex: :thumbsup: If metrics are stable at +10m, we'll proceed to staged rollout. If anything odd, trigger rollback immediately and post `rollback-now` in this thread.
maria: tiny note — embedding test showed a small perf blip at 30s into the request when batch-size=64. I've added a throttled test and set canary batch-size=32.
sunil: Saw the blip in infra metrics, but it recovered. Watching for recurrence.
jess: publishing note: set the feature flag `new_embedding_cache` to `on` after stage 2. Documented in release notes.
alex: Okay team — final call in 15m. If nobody objects, we will open the change window and run the staged rollout. Post any objections now.
tim: No objections from infra.
maria: All clear from gatekeeper.
sunil: ✅ oncall ready.
jess: No blockers.
alex: Go for change window in T-minus 5. I'll post the official start in 5.
deploy-bot: Change window opened by alex at 1718888042. Canary at 5% running.
alex: Tracking — will close thread when rollout completes or rollback occurs. Thanks everyone.
